##### Project general facts

London Square Pearson Building is a landmark residential tower offering one and two-bedroom private apartments. The tower rises above a new public square that opens up views of the Grade I listed St Michael and All Angels Church, with shops and eateries at ground level. From the upper floors, residents enjoy sweeping views towards the London skyline.

Landscaped terraces and a podium garden provide generous outdoor space. Communal internal spaces with Wi-Fi, including a residents' lounge, make it easy to socialise, relax or hold virtual meetings, while a dedicated cycle store is also provided.

Apartments feature smart fitted kitchens with integrated appliances, contemporary bathrooms and premium floor finishes, with underfloor heating throughout and a washer dryer in the hall service cupboard. Each home includes a bright winter garden, ideal for entertaining friends, and the main bedroom features fitted wardrobes with mirrored sliding doors.

##### Parking

Cycle parking.

##### Location description and benefits

West Croydon is a well-connected part of Croydon, set directly on the high street. The area offers major shopping at the Whitgift and Centrale centres, alongside a lively mix of independent boutiques, cafés, restaurants, local markets and Boxpark.

West Croydon station, with train, bus and tram services, is only a short walk away, and East Croydon station is close by for trains to London Bridge and Gatwick Airport. Gardens and parks, Croydon College and the Fairfield Halls arts and entertainment centre are all within easy reach.

Croydon is evolving into a creative hub with its own identity and excellent transport links to central London and Gatwick Airport. Its high street setting and transport links make the neighbourhood a well-connected choice for both living and investment.
